en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a quiet residential square with several similar two-story brick houses with hipped roofs arranged around an open, circular or oval green space. A wide unpaved or lightly paved street curves around the square. One building with decorative brickwork and a small tree in front is close to the right edge, while more houses extend into the distance on the left. The style suggests planned workers' or middle-class housing from the early 20th century. Handwritten-style printed text at the top left names the location.
